description: This file defines the Relationship class in the Drupal JSON:API module, representing resource object relationships, including methods for creation, link management, and metadata handling.

classes.name: Relationship
classes.description: Represents references from one resource object to other resource object(s) within Drupal's JSON:API module, managing relationship data, links, and metadata.

methods.name: createFromEntityReferenceField
methods.description: Creates a Relationship instance from an entity reference field, establishing links and metadata based on the context resource object.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the context resource object associated with this relationship.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the public field name of the relationship.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Returns the collection of links related to this relationship.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with this relationship.

methods.name: getOmissions
methods.description: Returns omitted data, as per interface implementation.

methods.name: getMergedLinks
methods.description: Merges top-level links with relationship-specific links, prioritizing overrides.

methods.name: getMergedMeta
methods.description: Deep merges top-level metadata with relationship metadata.

methods.name: buildLinkCollectionFromEntityReferenceField
methods.description: Constructs a collection of links for a given entity reference field, adding 'self' and 'related' links as appropriate.
